model_basis: Completed post-LaMelo trade + confirmed Clark/Bones re-signings; VERIFIED 2026-27 thresholds.

min_added_as_extra_body.note: LeBron as a 15th man ON TOP of a filled 14. The naive 'just add him' case.

min_swapped_for_a_minimum_body.note: LeBron REPLACES the 14th/15th minimum body. The realistic path if legal.

taxpayer_mle_added.note: The MLE MIN nominally keeps, but only if it fits under the hard cap.

verdict.hard_cap_trigger: salary aggregation in the LaMelo four-team trade
verdict.feasibility_conclusion: LeBron fits ONLY at the veteran minimum and ONLY as a SWAP for an existing minimum body (not as an addition). The taxpayer MLE is INFEASIBLE (it blows the hard cap). So the four-time MVP can be added, if at all, only as a minimum-for-minimum swap that keeps the roster the same size. He is not additive; he is a substitution, and the hard cap is the reason. Availability is then the whole game: a 41-turning-42 body in a spot that otherwise holds a healthier 65-75 game minimum player.
